case_title: HERRERA, ANDRES et al VS KIRIKOVA, IRINA et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,700.00 FILED BY HERRERA, ANDRES HERRERA, SHIRLEY AS TO DEFENDANT KIRIKOVA, IRINA KIRIKOV, YEVGENIY KONONOVA, SARRA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-01-2001 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT KIRIKOVA, IRINA

SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION MAR-01-2001, CONTINUED BY COURT TO MAR-29-2001 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506 YEVGENIY KIRIKOV AND SARRA KONONOVA ARE ADDED AS DEFENDANTS. KIROKOVA IRITLA IS CORRECTED TO: IRINA KIRIKOVA. YEVGENIY KIRIKOVA WAIVES SERVICE OF PROCESS.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE AS TO DEFENDANT KIRIKOV, YEVGENIY KONONOVA, SARRA ANDRES HERRERA IS DISMISSED & IS REPLACED BY SHIRLEY HERRERA AS PLTF. IRINA KIRIKOVA IS DIS- MISSED W/ PREJUDICE. IRINA KIRIKOVA IS NOT A TENANT.THE TENANTS DO NOT OWE PLTF ANY MONEY FOR GARBAGE BILLS BECAUSE THE WRITTEN RENTAL AGREE- MENT DOES NOT INDICATE THAT THE TENANTS ARE RES- PONSIBLE FOR GARBAGE BILLS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
THE REMAINDER OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE UNTIL SUCH TIME THAT THE TENANCY TERMINATES.
